name: MPF102
description: General-purpose small-signal N-channel JFET in TO-92, originally marketed for RF amplifier and low-ON-resistance analog switching applications. Extremely common in buffer and preamp stages in guitar pedal and vintage audio circuits alongside the 2N5457/J201. TO-92 lead order is D-S-G.

TO-92.notes: Per Fairchild's own pinout: 1. Drain 2. Source 3. Gate, flat face toward you, leads down.

extra.Vgs(off): -8.0V max @ VDS=15V, ID=2nA (Vgs -0.5 to -7.5V typ range @ ID=200uA)

typical_application: Source-follower buffers, instrument input stages, and JFET preamps; also usable as a low-ON-resistance analog switch or small RF amplifier. Self-bias with a source resistor sized from the measured IDSS.
gotchas: depletion-mode: conducts at Vgs=0; needs negative Vgs to reduce current
wide IDSS (2-20mA) and Vgs(off) spread between individual parts; measure or trim for repeatable bias, do not assume datasheet typicals
originally an RF/switching part, not audio-specific, but widely reused in audio buffer circuits alongside the 2N5457 and J201
